summary:
1990s-style McMansion on a 44x32 lot: a stone-veneer and beige-siding block with a two-storey quartz-column portico under a tall front gable (ridge y14), an L-plan hip, a three-car garage cross-gable with dormers, a conical turret bay and a 3x3 stone chimney, all in dark slate shingle.
Walls y1..9 (floor1 y1, floor2 y5, rooms 3 high, foyer 7 high); 20 rooms, each walkable from the portico entrance (22,2,7); foyer stair and chandelier built by a dedicated part.
Six parts: shell, roofs, front, grounds, rear and deck, stair. elements.md has 41 ticked elements, plan.md has the openings and reserved cells.

McMansion shell: P1 shell built in parts/shell.mjs: foundation y0, storey floors y1/y5, y9 ceiling, all exterior walls with veneer/belt/quoins/sills, S1/S2 partitions, turret, chimney, portico pilasters; openings reserved and left air. make.sh writes a whole build.nbt (3773 placed, 0 refused, 0 off-palette); mcd check shows no floating/unsupported blocks; front tiles read as the two-storey massing.
polish: E03 turret: cone roof is P2, arched glass is P3 (walls are built).
E13 garage: carriage-door leaves and straps are P3, side and mudroom doors are P5 (walls and openings are built).
E30 foyer: stair cells, banister and chandelier are P6 (void and ceiling are built).
Shutters, archWin fills, portico entablature and column caps, and the cased/French door fills are P3/P5, as the plan assigns them.

summary:

make.sh wrote a whole build.nbt; the Roofs line shows 1358 placed, no REFUSED writes, no OFF-PALETTE. Checklist P2 and E01-E05 ticked in plan.md and elements.md, with deviations noted in plan.md.

R1 ridge tops at y14, not y13 (pitch 0.5 gives 5 courses, maxHeight 4 unreachable). R3 and R5 top at y13.
R2 ridge is bare (no ridge cap; ROOF_NO_RIDGE warning). R1 has no north or west overhang, to avoid the turret and R3.
